issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The change only swaps one Morgan count fingerprint (radius 2, 2048 bits) for three concatenated ones (radii 1, 2, 3, 1024 bits each) and keeps the MACCS keys. It adds no file or network access, uses no test labels and pastes in no answers.

No new bug that would make the result meaningless. One existing weakness, also in the incumbent: featurize silently skips SMILES that RDKit can't parse ('if mol:'), so a bad SMILES would shift the rows out of line with the labels or predictions. It isn't a problem today because the jobs ran normally and no integrity flags were raised.

The numbers support the reject. The candidate scored 0.0941 against an incumbent mean of 0.0932, so it is 0.0009 worse. Assuming a noise sd of 0.0049 per run, the standard error of the difference is 0.0049*sqrt(1/1+1/2) ≈ 0.0060, which gives z ≈ -0.15. This matches the reported -0.154; the small gap is likely rounding in the means. The difference is well inside the noise.
